A LITTLE NOTE, JUST FOR YOU

My love,

A little bouquet for you, just because. If I could, I'd hand you these tulips and stay for the smile on your face.

Thank you for making even the ordinary days feel special. I hope this little corner of the internet reminds you how loved you are.

On the busy days, the quiet days, and all the days in between, I'm always cheering for you.

I love you, always.

Always yours
